description: This Java source file defines the ContentManagementServices class, which provides static methods for managing content entities, including retrieving, persisting, and updating content, content associations, and related resources within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for handling content creation, updates, associations, site roles, and permission checks.

classes.name: ContentManagementServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing content, content associations, site roles, and related resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getSubContent
methods.description: Retrieves sub-content related to a given content ID and map key, utilizing ContentWorker to fetch cache and content view.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Fetches content view for a specified content ID using ContentWorker cache.

methods.name: persistContentAndAssoc
methods.description: Creates or updates Content, ContentAssoc, and ElectronicText entities, handling permissions, associations, and content purposes.

methods.name: updateSiteRoles
methods.description: Updates publish site roles tied to a content ID for a specific party, managing role creation and deactivation.

methods.name: persistDataResourceAndData
methods.description: Checks permissions and persists DataResource and associated data, including image data handling.

methods.name: persistDataResourceAndDataMethod
methods.description: Performs the actual creation or update of DataResource and ElectronicText entities, including validation of uploaded files.
